Director of Engineering

Product Development - United States (Remote)

Regroup Mass Notification — a global company with headquarters in Dallas — is looking for a Director of Engineering. Regroup believes in working with talented yet humble people who care about our core mission: keeping communities and organizations safe and informed.

We are seeking a seasoned engineering leader with deep software and SaaS experience to own the technical direction of our platform and lead our globally dispersed engineering organization. You will set the bar for how we build, ship, and run software, partnering closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Sales, and Marketing to turn strategy into reliable, life-saving products. Our product leadership, will work hand in hand with you, and you will help shape the roadmap as much as deliver it.



Show us what you’ve got! (aka requirements)

  • 5 or more years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a software or SaaS environment
  • 4 or more years in engineering leadership, including at least 3 years as a manager or a head of multiple teams
  • Proven experience directly managing an engineering team of 10 or more people, including hiring, performance management, and career development
  • A track record of delivering complex, high-availability products at scale, from architecture through launch and ongoing operations
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of modern web/mobile application architecture and the AWS technology stack, including security, scalability, and observability
  • Experience owning engineering budgets, headcount planning, and vendor or contractor relationships
  • Fluency with agile delivery, CI/CD, and DevOps practices, and the judgment to adapt process to the team rather than the other way around
  • A pragmatic interest in how AI-assisted tools can help engineers work smarter, paired with the judgment to know where they fit and where they don’t
  • A natural leader with an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong bias for action
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound technical trade-offs under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, customers, and non-technical teams
  • Someone who builds strong teams and also rolls up their sleeves when needed. We are a global company with many different branches — comfort leading people across countries, time zones, and cultures, with an open heart to all of them, is a must.
  • BS/BA required in Computer Science or a related technical field; MS plus (or equivalent work experience)
  • Background check



What do you want to do? (aka key responsibilities)

  • Lead, grow, and mentor a distributed engineering organization of 10+ engineers and engineering managers across development, QA, and DevOps
  • Own the technical vision, architecture, and long-term platform strategy, aligned with company goals and the product roadmap
  • Partner with the Product Director and product leadership to shape roadmaps, assess feasibility, and balance new features against technical debt and non-functional requirements
  • Ensure the reliability, security, and performance of a mission-critical notification platform where uptime genuinely matters
  • Establish and continually improve engineering standards, delivery processes, code quality, and incident response
  • Set and report on engineering metrics, including delivery velocity, quality, system health, and team engagement, to executive leadership
  • Plan and manage headcount, budget, and resourcing, including recruiting top talent and building a strong hiring pipeline
  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and psychological safety
  • Represent engineering with customers, partners, and auditors on technical and security matters when needed
  • Work closely with Sales and Marketing to support go-to-market efforts and deliver quick time-to-market solutions



Some of what we have to offer you

  • Great culture and environment
  • Flexible work environment, including remote work opportunities
  • Smart people to learn from
  • Cutting-edge experience
  • A mission-driven career that literally saves lives. At our core, we keep institutions afloat and efficient by making communications easy and effective. We keep individuals and entire communities safe by offering best-in-class emergency notifications on any device.



How you will succeed and grow at Regroup

We believe in leading with love and doing our best. If this sounds like you, then we should probably talk sooner than later.

A background check is required.
Only resumes written in English will be considered.
A good computer and a reliable home internet connection are a must.
